identitySignals: villagepublichealth.org says the organization began in 2018 as 'Mumford and Associates' and rebranded to Village Public Health in 2021, matching the agenda's 'Mumford and Associates dba Village Public Health'
The Village Public Health homepage lists an 'OUSD Expanded Learning Program' partner logo, matching OUSD's expanded learning (after-school and summer) contracts
research.notes: Medium confidence: the name history and the OUSD Expanded Learning logo match, but the site presents the organization as Arkansas-based (Little Rock) while the agenda gives Oakland, CA. The EIN 93-1701910 on the site and ProPublica belongs to 'Village Public Health Training Center' (501(c)(3), exempt July 2024), which is likely a separate, newer entity from the contracting party 'Mumford and Associates, LLC', so EIN, legal name and headquarters were left null. California Secretary of State and SAM.gov were not checked (web search budget exhausted). A reviewer should confirm whether the Oakland contractor is the same business as the Arkansas organization.

profile.summary: Village Public Health is a prevention-focused health education organization for young people ages 14 to 24, their families and communities. It offers health coaching, youth mental health training, healthy relationships education and workforce development. It began in 2018 as Mumford and Associates and took the Village Public Health name in 2021.
